title: Vigilant Guard Search and Rescue
description: B-ROLL: U.S. Army Soldiers from the S. C. Army National Guard's 265th Engineer Detachment (Firefighters) stationed at McCrady Training Center in Eastover, S.C. work with the Georgetown County Technical Rescue team and Midway Fire and Rescue March 8, 2015 to shore up the walls of a partially collapsed building prior to further search and rescue operations during Vigilant Guard 2015. Vigilant Guard is a regional training exercise sponsored by U.S. Northern Command in conjunction with the National Guard Bureau. The exercise allows the National Guard to train with state and local governments and provides and opportunity to leverage partnerships and working relationships. Vigilant Guard is being held March 3 through 12.
